meta.name: db-postgres
meta.description: Query PostgreSQL databases configured in .env (DB_POSTGRES_N_*). Use when the user asks to query, explore, or audit data in a Postgres database. Picks connection by label (e.g. 'msgops-dev', 'bms-prod') or numeric index. Read-only by default — writes refused unless DB_POSTGRES_N_ALLOW_WRITE=true on that block.

copy.tagline: 查询和探索 PostgreSQL 数据库中的数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速查询或审计 PostgreSQL 数据库中的数据
copy.tagline_en: Query and explore data in PostgreSQL databases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly query or audit data in a PostgreSQL database

howto.what: Claude能查询、探索或审计PostgreSQL数据库。默认只读，除非允许写操作。它会根据标签或索引选择连接，执行SQL并返回JSON结果，也可列出表、描述列结构。
howto.when: 当你要求查询、探索或审计PostgreSQL数据库时触发。你可以指定数据库标签（如“msgops-dev”）或索引；未指定时Claude会列出可用连接。

say.text: 查询msgops-dev数据库过去7天的用户数量。
say.note: Claude会执行SELECT count(*)并返回结果。

say.text: 列出bms-prod数据库中所有表的名称。
say.note: Claude会调用tables命令并展示表列表。
Claude会调用describe命令返回列信息。

howto.what_en: Claude can query, explore, or audit PostgreSQL databases configured in .env. Read-only by default; writes only if ALLOW_WRITE=true. It picks a connection by label or index, executes SQL, returns JSON results, and can list tables or describe columns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to query, explore, or audit a PostgreSQL database. You can specify a connection by label (e.g., 'msgops-dev') or index; if unspecified, Claude lists available connections first.

say_en.text: Count users created in the last 7 days on msgops-dev.
say_en.note: Claude runs SELECT count(*) and returns the result.

say_en.text: List all tables in bms-prod database.
say_en.note: Claude runs the tables command and shows the list.

say_en.text: Describe the users table structure in msgops-dev.
say_en.note: Claude runs describe and returns column details.
